issueSource.subject: fix: add /roadmap to public endpoints check
issueSource.body:
The /roadmap route was broken because it wasn't included in the public
endpoints check. Requests to /roadmap would fall through to the auth check
and return 401 Unauthorized instead of serving the roadmap page.
